_about: 17 Oct 2026. The US firm for the Delpat product film (cutroom, films/demos/real-estate-crm): an invented residential brokerage in Austin, TX, on the `us` market preset. It replaces the Indian film firm (film.json, same slug) when built. Development database only. The firm, its people and its three buildings are invented and were searched for: no Austin business or building with these names turned up (web search, not a TREC licence check). Neighbourhoods are real public names.

_sources.what: Austin chosen: a mid-size metro (city about 980,000, July 2023 estimate) with a deep resale and rental market, published MLS data (Unlock MLS) and a clear spread between central and suburban prices
City of Austin median sale $560,000 (Aug 2026, Unlock MLS); metro $412,000; Redfin: average 57 days on market
Single-family median $582,500 and condo median $390,000, Austin, 2026 year to date (Unlock MLS, via a brokerage)
_sources.note: search-result text; the page refused our fetch. priceIndex 1.0 is the $582,500 single-family median

_sources.what: No commercial stock: 70% of NAR members are primarily residential. For a profile that wants offices: Austin full-service office asking rent $50.47/sq ft/yr (Cushman & Wakefield, Q3 2026); retail NNN about $26-27/sq ft/yr (Partners, Transwestern, Q1 2026, search text only)

market.summary: A residential resale brokerage across central Austin and its northern and southern suburbs. Buyers and sellers are most of the book; a leasing agent works rentals. Condos sit in a few buildings; houses and townhouses stand on their own.
